instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): conversionPeriods = input(9, minval=1, title="Conversion Line Length", group = "Ichimoku Settings"); basePeriods = input(26, minval=1, title="Base Line Length", group = "Ichimoku Settings"); laggingSpan2Periods = input(52, minval=1, title="Lagging Span 2 Length", group = "Ichimoku Settings"); displacement = input(26, minval=1, title="Displacement", group = "Ichimoku Settings"); entryStrategy = input(title = "Entry Strategy", defval = "Ichimoku", options = ["Ichimoku"], type = input.string, group = "Entry Strategy"); exitStrategy = input(title = "Exit Strategy", defval = "Ichimoku", options = ["Ichimoku","ATR Pullback"], type = input.string, group = "Position Exit Settings"); exitATRLength = input(14, title = "ATR Length", minval = 1 ,type = input.integer, group = "Position Exit Settings"); exitATRMult = input(2, title = "ATR Multiplier", minval = 0.1 , step = 0.1 ,type = input.float, group = "Position Exit Settings"); riskReward = input(2, title = "Risk Reward Ratio", minval = 0.1 , step = 0.1 ,type = input.float, group = "Position Exit Settings"); closeLagBelow = input(true, title = "Close long position if lagging span crosses below the price", type = input.bool, group = "Position Exit Settings"); closelagAbove = input(true, title = "Close short position if lagging span crosses above the price", type = input.bool, group = "Position Exit Settings"); showDash = input(true, title = "Show Dashboard", type = input.bool, group = "Dashboard Options"); colorDash = input(color.new(#696969, 80), title = "Background Color", type = input.color, inline = "Dash Colors", group = "Dashboard Options"); colorTextDash = input(color.new(#FFFFFF,0), title = "Text Color", type = input.color, inline = "Dash Colors", group = "Dashboard Options"); distance = input(30, title = "Bars Distance (to rigth)", minval = 1 ,type = input.integer, group = "Dashboard Options"); showSignals = input(true, title = "Show Signals (long/short)", type = input.bool, group = "Extra Options"); showTargets = input(true, title = "Show Targets (Profit/Loss)", type = input.bool, group = "Extra Options") | Indicator calls: lowest(len); highest(len); atr(exitATRLength)
entry_long: Source rule: not long with all conditions true conAbvBase with all conditions true cloudGreen with all conditions true closeAbvCloud with all conditions true lagSpanAbvCloud
entry_short: Source rule: not short with all conditions true conBlwBase with all conditions true cloudRed with all conditions true closeBlwCloud with all conditions true lagSpanBlwCloud
exit: Source rule: closeLagBelow with all conditions true open  is below  close[displacement + 1]; order: strategy.close("Long", alert_message = "Long Closed by Lagging Span Crossing Below Price"); Source rule: high[1]  is at least  profit with either condition true low[1]  is at most  loss; order: strategy.close("Long", alert_message = "Long Closed"); Source rule: closelagAbove with all conditions true open  exceeds  close[displacement + 1]; order: strategy.close("Short", alert_message = "Short Closed by Lagging Span Crossing Above Price"); Source rule: low[1]  is at most  profit with either condition true high[1]  is at least  loss; order: strategy.close("Short", alert_message = "Short Closed"); Source rule: conditionLong; order: strategy.exit("Long exit", "Long", limit = profit, stop = loss, alert_message = "Long Position Close"); Source rule: conditionShort; order: strategy.exit("Short exit","Short", limit = profit, stop = loss, alert_message = "Short Position Close")
stop_loss: strategy.exit("Long exit", "Long", limit = profit, stop = loss, alert_message = "Long Position Close"); strategy.exit("Short exit","Short", limit = profit, stop = loss, alert_message = "Short Position Close")
take_profit: strategy.exit("Long exit", "Long", limit = profit, stop = loss, alert_message = "Long Position Close"); strategy.exit("Short exit","Short", limit = profit, stop = loss, alert_message = "Short Position Close")
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
